metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over Chiang Mai, Thailand during March 2024 compared to May 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS monthly aerosol products over Chiang Mai (Point 98.9931E, 18.7877N; 20 km buffer). Compare March 2024 vs May 2024. Primary: MODIS/061/MOD08_M3 (Terra). Fallback: MODIS/061/MYD08_M3 (Aqua). 2. Masking strategy: Monthly gridded AOD already aggregated; no cloud masking. We validate using pixel counts from reduceRegion. 3. Logic: If collection size is 0 for a month, try fallback; if both fail → C1. If reduceRegion count is 0 → C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside [0,5] → C3. Otherwise compare March > May → A else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([98.9931, 18.7877]); const region = center.buffer(20000); // 20 km const periods = { Mar: {start: '2024-03-01', end: '2024-04-01'}, May: {start: '2024-05-01', end: '2024-06-01'} }; async function fetchMonthlyAOD(start, end) { const sources = ['MODIS/061/MOD08_M3', 'MODIS/061/MYD08_M3']; // Terra then Aqua let img = null, src = null, imgsCount = 0; for (const id of sources) { const col = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterDate(start, end); const size = await col.size().getInfo(); if (size > 0) { img = ee.Image(col.first()); src = id.split('/').pop(); imgsCount = size; break; } } if (!img) return {status: 'C1', src: null, imgsCount: 0}; const bandNames = await img.bandNames().getInfo(); let band = null; if (bandNames.includes('AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined_Mean')) { band = 'AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined_Mean'; } else if (bandNames.includes('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean_Mean_Mean')) { band = 'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean_Mean_Mean'; } else { return {status: 'D', src, imgsCount}; } const bandImg = img.select(band); let scale = await bandImg.projection().nominalScale().getInfo(); if (!scale || !isFinite(scale)) scale = 1000; const countDict = await bandImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const count = countDict ? countDict[band] : 0; if (!count || count === 0) return {status: 'C2', src, imgsCount, band, count: 0}; const meanDict = await bandImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const mean = meanDict ? meanDict[band] : null; if (mean === null || !isFinite(mean) || isNaN(mean)) return {status: 'C3', src, imgsCount, band, count}; if (mean < 0 || mean > 5) return {status: 'C3', src, imgsCount, band, count, mean}; return {status: 'OK', src, imgsCount, band, count, mean}; } // 2. Data Acquisition & Checks const mar = await fetchMonthlyAOD(periods.Mar.start, periods.Mar.end); const may = await fetchMonthlyAOD(periods.May.start, periods.May.end); console.log('Region: Chiang Mai, TH (20km buffer)'); console.log(`Mar2024 src: ${mar.src || 'None'}, imgs: ${mar.imgsCount}`); console.log(`May2024 src: ${may.src || 'None'}, imgs: ${may.imgsCount}`); // Handle error cases if (mar.status === 'C1' || may.status === 'C1') { console.log('C1'); return; } if (mar.status === 'C2' || may.status === 'C2') { console.log('C2'); return; } if (mar.status === 'C3' || may.status === 'C3') { console.log('C3'); return; } if (mar.status === 'D' || may.status === 'D') { console.log('D'); return; } // 3. Processing & Output console.log(`Mar AOD: ${mar.mean.toFixed(3)} (px:${mar.count})`); console.log(`May AOD: ${may.mean.toFixed(3)} (px:${may.count})`); const diff = mar.mean - may.mean; console.log(`Diff (Mar - May): ${diff.toFixed(3)}`); // 4. Final Answer if (!isFinite(diff)) { console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(diff > 0 ? 'A' : 'B'); } catch (err) { console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
